name: Windows Defender Antivirus Threats Detected
description: Identifies Windows Defender AV threat detection events that may indicate malware activity or false positives from authorized tools.
query:
sequence by host.id
  [process where event.type == "start" and process.name : "MpCmdRun.exe" and process.args : "-Scan"]
  [file where event.action == "deletion" and file.path : "C:\\Users\\*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*"]
